Session date: 3:47 pm on 17 March, 2022
[D1:1] John: Hey! Glad to finally talk to you. I want to ask you, what motivates you?
[D1:2] James: Hey John! Video games give me tons of joy and excitement, so they keep me motivated!
[D1:3] John: Cool, James! I'm a big video game fan too. They help me relax after a long day. What game are you currently enjoying the most?
[D1:4] James: I'm totally into The Witcher 3 right now. The story and atmosphere are amazing. Have you tried it yet?
[D1:5] John: Haven't played it yet, but I hear it's awesome. Gonna give it a go. BTW, just signed up for a programming class. Have you ever done any programming?
[D1:6] James: Programming is an awesome skill. I tried it out one in college and now it`s all my life. Good luck in the class! Do you have any coding experience?
[D1:7] John: I did a bit of coding in HTML and CSS a few years back. Thought I'd refresh those skills in this course. What languages do you like most and any projects you've done?
[D1:8] James: I've worked with Python and C++. I've built a website and also created some game mods. Here is one example.
[D1:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen showing a video game scene
[D1:9] John: That mod looks amazing! The graphics are awesome. What other programming languages have you worked with?
[D1:10] James: I haven’t worked with any other programming languages, but I hope to work in the future.
[D1:11] John: Maybe in the future we will develop mobile applications together? Do you like the idea?
[D1:12] James: It would be cool! For example, we could write some kind of application for dogs. By the way, my dogs.
[D1:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs are tied to a fence with a leash
[D1:13] John: Aww, they're adorable! What are the names of your pets? And what are your plans for the app?
[D1:14] James: Max and Daisy. Will be actually cool to build an app for dog walking and pet care. The goal is to connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and provide helpful information on pet care.
[D1:15] John: Sounds good, James! Bet that app would find a lot of buyers. What sets it apart from other existing apps?
[D1:16] James: Thanks, John! The personal touch really sets it apart. Users can add their pup's preferences/needs - just like they were customizing it for them. Making it unique for each owner and pup.
[D1:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notepad with a handwritten note on it
[D1:17] John: That's a great idea! Your pup is gonna love it. Speaking of personal touches, what motivates you to work on your programming projects?
[D1:18] James: Creating something and seeing it come to life gives me a great sense of accomplishment. It's an amazing feeling. I write down all my goals in a notebook. It's very satisfying to check off each one when it's done.
[D1:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a notebook with a list of things on it
[D1:19] John: What are you working on that has you feeling so accomplished?
[D1:20] James: I'm working on something I've wanted to do since I was a kid. Even as a child, I made some sketches of the main character. Back then I was just drawing comics, but now I want to turn it into a computer game. It's a project that has me really excited.
[D1:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a drawing of a girl in a plane
[D1:21] John: Wow, James! That's amazing. What made you decide to work on it and create your own game?
[D1:22] James: I'm always excited to combine my favorite passions: gaming and storytelling. It's great creating my own project and bringing my ideas to life, plus the challenge is really enjoyable!
[D1:23] John: That sounds really fulfilling! Combining your passions to make something new must be so exciting. Can't wait to see the outcome.
[D1:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a medical chart with instructions for the procedure
[D1:24] James: Thanks John! It's super exciting. I'll keep you updated on the progress. Perhaps, thanks to your knowledge of HTML, I'll invite you to help with some things in my game.
[D1:25] John: It will be great to work with you, James.
[D1:26] James: I'll be looking forward to it. By the way, yesterday I went bowling and got 2 strikes. I love bowling!
[D1:27] John: I'm sure you're very good at this. Unfortunately, I can’t share my love for him with you, my fingers are too big. Perhaps I should take up exercise, at least start going for a run in the morning. And I also don’t like bowling itself, to be honest.
[D1:28] James: It's a pity, it would be nice to go play with you one day.
[D1:29] John: Well, I'm sure we can do something else. We can play slot machines and arcades, for example.
[D1:30] James: The last time I played at the slot machines, I was so engrossed in the game that I didn't notice my wallet being taken out of my pocket. Sad story.
[D1:31] John: I'm sorry to hear it. Well, I'll be nearby, I'll look after your pockets.
[D1:32] James: Still, maybe we can try something different?
[D1:33] John: Heard about VR gaming? It's pretty immersive. We can try it together!
[D1:34] James: I tried it - it's crazy how real it feels! Have you given it a shot?
[D1:35] John: Tried it a few times, it's insane how immersive that experience can be. Can't wait to try it together with you.
[D1:36] James: Yeah, VR gaming is awesome! Let`s do it next Saturday!
[D1:37] John: Agreed, James!
Session date: 9:26 pm on 20 March, 2022
[D2:1] James: Hey John, something awesome happened since we talked. I made a game avatar and joined a new platform. It's so fun exploring and chatting with other gamers - it's a whole new adventure every time! I feel like I'm part of a super cool online community.
[D2:2] John: Hey James, awesome! Glad you're enjoying it and connecting with others. Building a community is really cool, especially when you meet people who enjoy the same things.
[D2:3] James: Thanks, John! Connecting with other gamers has been great! We've shared tips, strategies, and stories about gaming. It's amazing how it brings people together, regardless of their backgrounds.
[D2:4] John: That's incredible! It's so cool how gaming can bring people together and create a strong bond, regardless of their background.
[D2:5] James: Yeah, it's our shared language and passion. It's been a refuge for me in tough times.
[D2:6] John: Yeah, gaming always helps me escape stress. It's amazing how it calms me down during tough times.
[D2:7] James: Games are my go-to when I'm feeling overwhelmed. It's like therapy. I can relax, forget my troubles, and get lost in another world.
[D2:8] John: Gotcha. Gaming can be a great way to take a break and escape for a while. Anything new you've been into lately?
[D2:9] James: Lately, I've been checking out different styles of it. It's been fun to try something fresh and test myself in other ways. What about you, John? Any new hobbies recently?
[D2:10] John: I've been getting into a new hobby recently. I bought a metal detector and walk along the beaches looking for something worthwhile.
[D2:11] James: Interesting, John! Sounds like an awesome immersive experience. Already found something interesting?
[D2:12] John: Mostly just bottle caps, but a couple of times I found coins, and once even a gold ring.
[D2:13] James: Cool, I wish you good luck in this matter! By the way, I've got something to show you.
[D2:14] John: Show me what you've got! What is it?
[D2:15] James: Check out this pic of my best buds having a blast in the park. They've brought so much joy to my life. My two dogs are the best pals ever, right?
[D2:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D2:16] John: They look like they're having a blast! Can they do any tricks?

Session date: 8:56 pm on 20 September, 2022
[D25:11] John: Cheers, James! Appreciate your offer to help. I'll definitely let you know when the testing is ready. By the way, here is the book that helped me create the puzzles for this game.

[D25:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a magazine with a picture of a cartoon character
[D25:15] John: I read it, too. This magazine has been great for me too. Tutorials, interviews with developers, and tips - all really helpful.
[D25:16] James: Wow, John! Glad that resource was useful - looks like it provides some good tips and tricks for game developers.
[D25:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a magazine with a picture of a cartoon character
[D25:17] John: Yeah, that magazine looks great! Have you also found it to be a good resource?
[D25:18] James: Of course! It's been great, filled with tutorials and developer interviews to help improve my game dev skills. Super useful!
[D25:19] John: Resources like that are great for improving our skills. Keep it up! How's your week been?
[D25:20] James: My week's been good. Just trying to find a balance between work and other activities. How about you, how's your week going?
[D25:21] John: As for me, this week has been chaotic with everything going on. But I'm powering through!
[D25:22] James: Sorry to hear about your busy week, John. Make sure to take some time for yourself and take care. You've got this!
[D25:23] John: I appreciate your help. Gonna make time for myself.
[D25:24] James: No worries, take care of yourself. Relax and recharge - you deserve it.
[D25:25] John: Thanks, man! I'll definitely take your advice. You're the best!
Session date: 9:20 am on 3 October, 2022
[D26:1] John: Hey James! Busy few weeks for sure, but I'm pushing through. Got an email about a volunteer gig at a game dev non-profit. It's something I've wanted to do for a while, and could be the perfect start to a career that combines my two loves - gaming and helping. So stoked!
[D26:2] James: Hey John, that sounds awesome! Combining your two loves - gaming and helping people - must be really exciting! So what kind of gig did they offer you?
[D26:3] John: They asked me to be a programming mentor for game developers. I'll be teaching coding and assisting with projects. I'm really excited to share my knowledge and motivate people who are passionate about gaming.
[D26:4] James: Wow, John! Mentoring programmers to make games sounds awesome! You must love it. How do you feel about starting this journey?
[D26:5] John: I'm so excited and inspired! It's a great chance to help them and boost my own skills. I love sharing what I know and seeing others reach their potential - it's so rewarding!
[D26:6] James: It's so rewarding to see how much joy you get from it. Keep going, you're doing great!
[D26:7] John: Thanks, James! Your support really means a lot. It's so fulfilling to use my skills to make a difference. I hope this opens more opportunities for me.
[D26:8] James: I'm sure it will lead to great things. You got this! Oh, and I got this cool video card last week - I'm so excited to jump into it again!
[D26:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer case with a red light on it
[D26:9] John: Cool, James! What kind of games are you excited to play on it?
[D26:10] James:  I'm super into RPGs, so I'm excited about getting this video card and playing some new games. Have you heard any great things about Cyberpunk 2077? Do you think this game is worthy of my attention?
[D26:11] John: Yeah, I played it - it's awesome! Such an immersive world and an amazing story. I'm sure you'll love it!
[D26:12] James: I'm so excited for it! The world and story sound perfect. Thanks for recommending it, John!
[D26:13] John: No worries, James! Hope you have a blast playing. Let me know what you think!
[D26:14] James: Cool, John. Will do! Take care, see ya!
[D26:15] John: Take care! Enjoy that new computer. Later!
Session date: 2:14 pm on 13 October, 2022
[D27:1] John: Hey James! How's it going? I had a blast last week when my programmer friends and I organized an online comp. It was awesome to see everyone show off their skills! Anything new in your life?
[D27:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a desk with a laptop and a monitor
[D27:2] James: Hey John, congrats! Something cool happened to me recently. I made my first game and released it for the gaming community - it was so exciting!
[D27:2] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a game of thrones with a dragon and a dragon
[D27:3] John: Congrats on releasing your game, James! Was it fulfilling to see players engage with the game world you created?
[D27:4] James:  It was so fulfilling to see players engage with the game world I created. I'm really happy they're having fun with something I put so much work into.
[D27:5] John: So cool that people are enjoying it! What inspired you to create it?
[D27:6] James: Playing video games was always great, but creating my own game was really special. Witcher 3 gave me a ton of inspiration, with its amazing world and story. Plus, it pushed me to create something cool.
[D27:7] John: The Witcher 3 obviously had a huge impact on you. You must have put a ton of hard work and dedication into your game. Do you have any plans for future game development?
[D27:8] James: I put in so much effort and it paid off - now, I'm ready to make more games in different genres and test out new ideas. I'm pumped to see where this journey leads!
[D27:9] John:  I can't wait to see where your journey leads and the new creations you come up with. Your determination and love for game development is incredible. Keep going and you'll do great things!
[D27:10] James: I'm really looking forward to creating more enjoyable experiences!
[D27:11] John: I'm here for you. Anything you need, count on me!
[D27:12] James: Thanks, John! Your support is really appreciated.
[D27:13] John: No worries, James! We make a good team.
[D27:14] James: Yeah, totally. You've always been there for me, John. Thanks for having my back.
Session date: 7:36 pm on 21 October, 2022
[D28:1] James: Hey John, long time no talk! So much has happened!
[D28:2] John: Hey James! I'm excited to catch up. What's been up lately?
[D28:3] James: Three days ago my apartment lost power - so annoying because I had just gotten to the big reveal in that game! Had to wait hours before playing again.
[D28:4] John: Ugh, that stinks! Losing power in the middle of a game is such a bummer. Did it mess up your progress?
[D28:5] James: Oof, it definitely messed up my progress. I lost some of it because I forgot to save. Frustrating, but now I know to save more often!
[D28:6] John: Lesson learned - save progress! By the way, I organized the programming seminar last week.
[D28:7] James: Wow, cool! How did it go? Did you learn anything cool?

Session date: 9:18 pm on 26 August, 2022
[D21:1] James: Hey John! Look how cute it is. My dog came to me today while I was playing on the console. What is new?
[D21:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a dog on a couch
[D21:2] John:  Your pup is so cute, remind me what's their name? I've been helping my younger siblings out with programming since they joined the programming course. It's really cool to see them get into it.
[D21:3] James:  His name's Ned and he's been awesome since I adopted him. I can't imagine life without him. It's great to hear that your siblings signed up for programming.
[D21:4] John: That's right, his name is Ned, how could I forget?!
[D21:5] James: Regarding your siblings, are you already working on anything cool with them?
[D21:6] John: Yeah! We're working on a cool project together that involves coding. It's a game and it's helping them learn.
[D21:7] James: Wow, learning and gaming sounds like a fantastic combination for coding education! Can you share more details about the game?
[D21:8] John: Yeah, they're playing a simple, text-based adventure game, working on their coding skills and having fun. I'm so proud of them! Maybe they'll even create their own video games, huh? Any new game designs on your mind?
[D21:9] James: Wow, sounds cool John! Learning coding with a text-based adventure game is impressive stuff. As for me, I've been trying out different genres of games and now I'm dying to create a strategy game like Civilization - love how complicated and in-depth they are. Fingers crossed, one day I'll make my own awesome strategy game!
[D21:10] John: Wow, James, that's impressive! It's gonna be awesome. Can't wait to see what you come up with!
[D21:11] James:  Are you free tomorrow?
[D21:12] John: Yes, tomorrow is my day off. Do you have any suggestions on how to spend tomorrow?
[D21:13] James: Yes, we can go to Starbucks for coffee if you want.
[D21:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a laptop computer with a colorful keyboard on a table
[D21:14] John: I don't mind meeting up, but why Starbucks? Maybe we can have a beer somewhere?
[D21:15] James: Well, how about we go to McGee's pub then? I heard they serve a great stout there!
[D21:16] John: Great idea, except I don't like dark beer. Maybe there's something else there?
[D21:17] James: Of course, there are also light beers!
[D21:18] John: Great, then I agree! See you tomorrow at McGee's Pub!
[D21:19] James: See you John, bye!
Session date: 6:53 pm on 1 September, 2022
[D22:1] James: Hey John! Been a while, but hope you're doing well. My Unity strategy game is finally finished—it took loads of time and effort, but I'm really proud. Your support and encouragement made a real difference. Thanks for believing in me!
[D22:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a screenshot of a stone building with a giant creature
[D22:2] John: Hey James! Congrats on finishing your game! It looks amazing and I'm so proud of you for all the hard work you put in. Can I see more of it? Got any other screenshots to show me?
[D22:3] James: I appreciate your support. Check out this screenshot from it.
[D22:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game screen showing a person on a horse
[D22:4] John: This game looks great! What inspired you to create it?
[D22:5] James: I've always loved playing strategy games like Civilization and Total War, so I decided to challenge myself and create one of my own.
[D22:6] John: That's awesome! I love those games too. It must have been quite an experience making your own. Did you face any difficulties during development?
[D22:7] James: It was a bit challenging to get everything right, balancing mechanics and ensuring fairness. But with some trial and error, I managed to get it to where I wanted it.
[D22:8] John: Wow, that must have been a challenge, especially since you had to make sure the game was enjoyable and balanced. Congratulations on completing it! What were some key takeaways from the experience?
[D22:9] James: Thanks, John! It was definitely a learning experience. Perseverance and patience are key, and I'm proud of what I created after sticking with it. Also, feedback and collaboration are essential, and the help from others really made the game better. It was great!
[D22:10] John: Awesome that you learned those lessons! Collaboration and feedback make a huge impact on any project. I've been teaching my siblings coding. It's been a fulfilling experience and they're already creating their own programs - amazing!
[D22:11] James: Wow, John! Cool seeing others learn with your help. What kind of programs are they making?
[D22:12] John: They're starting small, making basic games and stories. It's inspiring how fast they learn and the good time they're having.
[D22:13] James: Wow! It's inspiring how fast they learn and the good time they're having. I bet they'll be creating their own complex projects soon!
[D22:14] John: I'm excited to see how far they can go! With their passion for video games like me, hopefully they can use those coding skills to make something cool. I'm so proud of them, can't wait to see what they come up with!
[D22:15] James: I'm proud of them too! Seeing the next generation pick up coding and making their own games is awesome. Can't wait to see what they create!
[D22:16] John: Thanks, James, for the support. I really appreciate it.
[D22:17] James: Yeah, you're the best! I'm here for you, no doubt.
[D22:18] John:  Your friendship really means a lot. I'm going through some difficult times now and it's really good to know I've got someone like you.
[D22:19] James: Just know I'm here if you need someone to talk or vent to. It might help alleviate some of the difficult times you're going through.
Session date: 9:23 pm on 4 September, 2022
[D23:1] James: Hey John, it's been a few days since we talked. So much has gone on, both good and bad. Yesterday, when we were at the theater, Samantha loves theater, I asked her to become my girlfriend, and she agreed. We have gone through a lot in this short period. There were good and bad, but I'm happy with her. All that ups and downs were a bit overwhelming, but it's part of life. What about you? Anything interesting lately?
[D23:2] John: Hey James, this is great news! Where else have you been besides the theater? My parents just started learning coding from me - it's been a learning experience, but I'm glad to help them out. It binds us a little closer. Look at this photo, this is my father coding his own program for the first time.
 
[D23:2] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a man sitting at a desk with a computer
[D23:3] James: That's great, John! Looks like he's having a good time in the pic. Samantha and I were also at McGee's bar. It turned out that she loves a good lager beer. She and I have so much in common!

Session date: 11:04 am on 23 April, 2022
[D7:12] James: Yeah, work can be tough. Is there something specific that's making it worse?

[D7:21] John:  Your words really helped. I won't quit. Gonna keep going. Cheers! 

[D7:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a quote written on it
Session date: 2:36 pm on 29 April, 2022
[D8:1] James: Hey John! What's up? Anything fun going on?

[D8:4] John: I'm actually working on a website for a local small business. It's my first professional project outside of class.
[D8:5] James: Congrats on your first professional project, John! Bet it's been great applying what you learned in class. How's the progress been?
[D8:6] John: Thanks, James! I've learned a lot and it's been an interesting journey so far. Progress is slow and there have been some hiccups along the way.
[D8:7] James: Yeah, nothing ever goes smooth. It's normal to have hiccups, but use them to learn and grow. Push through it and you'll make it!
[D8:8] John: You're right, I appreciate the boost. It's tough sometimes but I'm gonna keep pushing and make this work. Hiccups won't stop me.
[D8:9] James: What challenges have you encountered?
[D8:10] John: Figuring out how to get payments on the website was tough. I needed some help so I used some resources to understand the process. It's taken a while, but I'm getting closer to a solution.
[D8:11] James: That sounds challenging, but you're making progress. Hang in there! By the way, three days ago I bought myself an adventure book with fantasy novels and cool arts.
[D8:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a book open to a picture of a male character
[D8:12] John: Wow, that art's awesome! It takes me back to reading fantasy books.
[D8:13] James: Yeah, I love this genre. Got any suggestions?
[D8:14] John: Cool! Heard of "The Name of the Wind"? It's another great novel with awesome writing.
[D8:15] James: Never heard of it, but it sounds interesting. I'll definitely check it out. Thanks for the recommendation, John!
[D8:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book set of three books on a wooden table
[D8:16] John: Always happy to help. I'm sure you'll love this trilogy!
[D8:17] James: Look, I was playing a game and my faithful furry friend Daisy came and lay down next to me. This is so cute!
[D8:17] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog laying on a bed with a computer in the background
[D8:18] John: Awww, this is really so cute! Your furry friend looks so cozy. Do your dogs often come to you like this while playing?
[D8:19] James: Yeah, they love to watch me gaming and often hug me. Such good cuddle buddies! What game have you been playing lately?
[D8:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a blue controller in their hand
[D8:20] John: Awesome that you have them! I'm currently playing AC Valhalla, it's cool. Are you playing anything new?
[D8:21] James: Thanks, John! Valhalla is awesome. I'm trying out some strategy games like this. It's different but so cool!
[D8:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a map of the world on a tv screen
[D8:22] John: Is that Civilization VI? Heard good things about it. How's it?
[D8:23] James: This is a high-quality turn-based strategy game where you manage resources, lead armies, and conquer territories - challenging and cool!
[D8:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen showing a game of war
[D8:24] John: That sounds fun! What's the game like? Does it require a lot of strategy?
[D8:25] James: Sure, John! It requires a lot of strategy. It's all about planning, managing resources and making good decisions to beat your rivals. Every move matters!
[D8:26] John: Sounds intense but cool. I like games that test my strategizing. Does it help with your problem-solving?
[D8:27] James: Yeah, it's a great way to work on problem-solving and thinking. Plus, it's awesome to see your plans go the way you wanted and win!
[D8:28] John: Yeah! It's really satisfying when your plans work out and you win. How long have you been playing this game?
[D8:29] James: Been playing it for a month now - it's really challenged my strategy skills.

[D8:30] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a board game with a lot of cards on it
[D8:31] James: Sounds good! Board games are always a blast when you hang out with friends.
[D8:32] John: Yeah! They're great for having fun together.
[D8:33] James: Anything else that is fun to play with others?

You can only place a card with the same color or number on your opponent's card. Sometimes you trade cards, sometimes you need to draw a few extra from the deck or skip a turn.

Session date: 5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022
[D11:19] John: Thanks, James! Appreciate it. Take care and talk soon!
Session date: 7:33 pm on 23 May, 2022
[D12:1] James: Hey John, last weekend I had an awesome time at the amusement park with my friends. It was a great break from the virtual world. I went on some awesome roller coasters and it reminded me of when I was a kid. Everything was so real and exciting; it felt like I was in a video game!
[D12:2] John: Hey James! Sounds like an awesome time! I bet those rides brought back some great memories. Were there any other attractions besides the roller coaster?
[D12:3] James: Of course, I also managed to ride the Ferris wheel, electric cars and buggies. What's new with you?
[D12:4] John: That's really cool! Last Friday I entered a local tournament and took second place! It was a wild experience and the competitive energy was insane.
[D12:5] James: Wow, John that's awesome! Congrats on your achievement! I can imagine the rush you must have felt during the tournament. Did you receive any rewards or prizes for your success?
[D12:6] John: I was stoked about my achievement. Though I didn't win the tournament, I still received some money for the 2nd place. Seeing my effort pay off was awesome.
[D12:7] James: Awesome news! You don't have to win every time, growth and progress are most important. 
[D12:8] John: Yeah, I also got this trophy! So satisfying. It reminds me to always put in my best effort. What about you? Any success stories lately?
[D12:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a graduation cap on a book with a rope
[D12:9] James: Congrats on your achievement, John! That trophy looks awesome. Last month, I had a personal milestone. There were definitely tough times, but it reminds me of all the hard work. I feel a huge sense of accomplishment and I'm ready for the future opportunities!
[D12:10] John: Congrats on the milestone. What was it and what made it challenging? What did you learn?
[D12:11] James: I finished a big project I had been working on for months. It was challenging because I had to learn a new language and handle many details. I learned a lot about problem-solving, patience, and perseverance. Now I feel more confident to take on even bigger projects.
[D12:12] John:  That's awesome you learned a language and handled all those details. Great job, you definitely picked up some great skills! Remember, determination and confidence make any project a success. Good work!
[D12:13] James: Thanks, I appreciate your support. I'll definitely keep that in mind.
[D12:14] John: No worries, I'm here to help. Keep going and reach those goals!
Session date: 4:30 pm on 13 June, 2022
[D13:1] John: Hey James, long time no talk! A lot has happened during this time. Let me fill you in.
[D13:2] James: Hey John! Awesome to hear from you. Yeah, a lot has happened. Let's catch up!
[D13:3] John: I finally got my dream job! After lots of interviews and late nights, I got the offer and was ecstatic. Can't wait to start my journey!
[D13:4] James: Wow, John! Congrats on getting your dream job. I'm super stoked for you. When do you start?
[D13:5] John: Thank you! ! I'm starting next month.
[D13:6] James: It can be rough getting started, but I'm sure you'll do great. Don't be afraid to seek help if you need it. Can't wait to hear about your experience! By the way, I recently started a course that combines my passion for gaming and programming. It's fun and challenging, and it has definitely increased my excitement for both.
[D13:7] John: Cool! That sounds awesome. Combining your love of gaming and coding sounds like a dream. Tell me more! Are there any interesting projects you're working on?
[D13:8] James: Yes, we are currently working on a new part of the football simulator. I was working on collecting player databases. It wasn't easy, but I did it!
[D13:9] John: Cool! Did you choose this course because you love football?
[D13:10] James: Not least because of this. I love football, but, of course, the most important reason is to improve yourself. But it’s nice if it’s also connected with something you like.
[D13:11] John: I completely agree! By the way, did you watch the Liverpool vs Chelsea match?
[D13:12] James: Of course, they played well! As I like to say, there is no sport better than football, no club better than Liverpool! I don't miss a single match of theirs!
[D13:13] John: It looks like you really root for this team!
[D13:14] James: Absolutely! They are forever in my heart, they are a great team. I hope they become champions next season!
[D13:15] John: As a Manchester City fan, I can't agree with you. You'll see, our two teams will fight for the championship, and mine will win!
[D13:16] James: I'm sure you're wrong, John. Manchester City are in bad form and their transfer policy is terrible!
[D13:17] John: You may be right, but the City manager can handle it, you'll see!
[D13:18] James: I bet we'll be higher than you in the final standings!
[D13:19] John: I'll take the bet, James! This will be a great battle!
[D13:20] James: Sure, John!
Session date: 5:07 pm on 16 June, 2022
[D14:1] James: Hey John, how's it going? A lot has happened for me lately, some good and some not so great. I`m lucky to have at least two people who always help me out when I'm struggling. What about you?
[D14:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog laying on a person on a couch
[D14:2] John: Gad to hear you have your support system ready. It's crucial, especially during hard times. For me, it's been quite an emotional rollercoaster. Last week, I started my blog about coding. It's exciting and kinda scary too. This is the first picture I uploaded there.
[D14:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen with a program on it
[D14:3] James: Wow, starting a blog about coding is awesome! Must be so exciting. What do you think about it?
[D14:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game scene of a man and woman
[D14:4] John: Thanks, James! It has been an awesome and challenging experience. I'm loving sharing my coding journey with others and tracking everything. It's a great way to connect with other coders.
[D14:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen showing a number of items
[D14:5] James: Congrats on your coding journey! What`s more new in your world?
[D14:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a vase with a plaque on it
[D14:6] John: Well, I bought a lot of new books, and now my bookcase is almost completely filled!
[D14:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bookshelf with a lot of books on it
[D14:7] James: What genre do you enjoy reading?
[D14:8] John: I'm a big fan of sci-fi and fantasy books. Epic fantasy series with immersive world-building and intricate storylines are what I enjoy reading. Just getting lost in the pages of a great story is a wonderful escape from reality.
[D14:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book shelf with a few books on it
[D14:9] James: Cool! Are there any book series that you love and would recommend to others?
[D14:10] John: Definitely! Two of my favorites are "The Stormlight Archive" and "Kingkiller Chronicle". If SF is your thing, check out "The Expanse" series. It's epic!
[D14:11] James: Thanks for the recommendations, John! I'll definitely check out those books. What makes them your favorites?
[D14:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a cd with a picture of a knight on it
